methods.name: SetPadding
methods.description: Sets padding for the component. Use format: single value (e.g., '10') or four values (e.g., '10,20,30,40') for top, left, bottom, right.

methods.name: SetMargin
methods.description: Sets margin for the component. Use format: single value (e.g., '10') or four values (e.g., '10,20,30,40') for top, left, bottom, right.

methods.name: CreateGradientBackgroundTemplate
methods.description:
Creates or updates a gradient background template identified by a unique ID.
Parameters:
- id: Unique identifier for the gradient template.
- colorsList: List of colors for the gradient.
- orientation: Gradient orientation (see Orientation options).
- shape: Shape of the gradient background (see Shape options).
- cornerRadius: Corner radius for rounded corners (supports dimension units).
- strokeWidth: Width of the border stroke in pixels.
- strokeColor: Color integer for the stroke color.
If a template with the given ID exists, it will be replaced with the new one.

methods.name: ApplyGradientBackgroundTemplate
methods.description:
Applies a previously created gradient background template to the specified component.
Parameters:
- id: The unique identifier of the gradient template to apply.
- component: The component to which the gradient background will be applied.
Raises an error if the template ID does not exist.

methods.name: GradientBackground
methods.description:
Sets a gradient background to the specified view component.
Parameters:
- component: The view component to apply the gradient background.
- colorsList: List of colors used in the gradient.
- orientation: Gradient orientation (see Orientation options).
- shape: Shape of the gradient background (see Shape options).
- cornerRadius: Corner radius values as a CSV string (e.g., '10' or '10,20,30,40').
- strokeWidth: Width of the border stroke in pixels (multiplied by 5 internally).
- strokeColor: Color integer for the stroke color.

methods.name: FormatColor
methods.description:
Parses a color value. Supports:
- #RRGGBB (hex)
- #AARRGGBB (Android format)
- #RRGGBBAA (web/CSS/Figma format)
- #RRGGBB,alpha (0–100 alpha percent)
- RGB or RGBA (255,0,0 or 255,0,0,128)
- Color integer as string or number
Returns Android color int. Falls back to white if invalid.

methods.name: ColorOpacity
methods.description:
Parses a color input and applies an alpha transparency value.
Supports the following input formats:
- #RRGGBB (hexadecimal color)
- #AARRGGBB (Android ARGB format)
- #RRGGBBAA (web/CSS/Figma RGBA hex format)
- #RRGGBB,alpha (alpha as 0–100 percent)
- RGB or RGBA strings (e.g., "255,0,0" or "255,0,0,128")
- Color integer values (as string or numeric)
The alpha parameter accepts a percentage value between 0 and 100.
Returns an Android color integer with the specified opacity applied.
Defaults to white if the input is invalid.

events.name: Debug
events.description: Triggered when a debug message is generated. This event is only fired if debugging is enabled.
